name: Product Table Builder for WooCommerce – Drag & Drop Product Table, Wholesale Order Form, Quick Order Table
author: StorePlugin

sections.description:
Product Table Builder for WooCommerce turns your standard WooCommerce shop into a fast, searchable, and sortable product table – ideal for wholesale stores, B2B catalogs, restaurant ordering, quick order forms, and any shop with a large number of SKUs.

Instead of forcing customers to click through every product page, the plugin lists your WooCommerce products in a clean table layout where shoppers can see prices, images, SKUs, and variations at a glance, then add what they need to the cart in a single click.

No coding required. Build your table with a true drag-and-drop builder, choose which columns to show, configure your query, and publish – your table is ready to use anywhere on your site.

Documentation | Get Pro

Why use a product table for WooCommerce?

  • Speed up purchasing – customers add multiple products to the cart from one page.
  • Better for wholesale & B2B – show SKUs, stock, and prices in a structured grid.
  • Great for catalogs – restaurants, books, auto parts, takeaways, courses, and more.
  • Cleaner UX for large stores – replace endless grid scrolling with a sortable, searchable table.
  • Higher conversions – shorter path from browsing to checkout.

Key Features (Free)

  • Drag-and-Drop Table Builder – Create and arrange columns visually. No coding skills required.
  • Customizable Table Columns – Add, remove, and reorder elements like product Name, Price, SKU, Image, Categories, Tags, Attributes, Variations, and Add to Cart.
  • Appearance Customization – Adjust colors, fonts, borders, and other visual elements to match your brand.
  • Advanced Query Builder – Filter and display products based on category, tag, attribute, and other criteria so customers see exactly what you want them to.
  • Front-end Search – Let customers search products directly from the table.
  • Filter by Category, Tag & Attribute – Built-in filter controls for visitors to drill down into your catalog.
  • Sorting & Pagination – Sortable columns and pagination controls for easy navigation through large catalogs.
  • Add to Cart from the Table – Customers add products straight from the table without visiting the product page.
  • Floating Cart – Optional floating cart so shoppers always see what they’ve added.
  • Duplicate Tables – Clone an existing table in one click and reuse it.
  • Unlimited Tables – Build as many tables as you need.
  • WooCommerce HPOS Compatible – Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Perfect For

  • Wholesale and B2B stores
  • Quick order / one-page order forms
  • Restaurant and food ordering menus
  • Bookstores, and digital catalogs
  • Auto parts, hardware, and SKU-heavy stores
  • Course booking and event registration sites
  • Any shop where customers want to compare and buy quickly

Premium Features

Upgrade to Product Table Builder Pro to unlock advanced functionality:

  • Premium Table Elements – Author, Upsell, Cross-Sell, Custom Text, Spacer, and many more columns to enrich your product data.
  • Advanced Query Options – Filter by Price, Featured status, Stock Quantity, Product Type, Author, and more.
  • Mobile-Responsive Tables – Tables that adapt beautifully to phones and tablets for the best mobile shopping experience.
  • Advanced Design & Typography – Full control over typography, spacing, and styling for a fully branded look.
  • Import / Export – Move tables and styles between sites, or back them up for safe keeping.
  • Priority Support – Faster, more personal support from our team.

Upgrade to Pro →

Compatibility

  • WooCommerce 6.5+
  • WordPress 5.3+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)
sections.installation:
Installing Product Table Builder for WooCommerce is easy:

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New and search for “Product Table Builder for WooCommerce”. Or upload the product-table-builder-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to Product Tables in your WordPress admin menu and click Add New to build your first table.
  5. Configure your columns, query, appearance, and publish – your table is ready to embed.
sections.faq:
Is Product Table Builder free?

Yes. The lite version is 100% free and includes the drag-and-drop builder, query builder, search, filters, sorting, pagination, and Add to Cart. A Pro version is available with extra columns, advanced query options, mobile-responsive tables, and import/export.

Do I need WooCommerce to use this plugin?

Yes. Product Table Builder is built specifically for WooCommerce stores and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Is Product Table Builder compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Is there a limit to how many product tables I can create?

No. You can create unlimited product tables and use them across as many pages as you like.

Can customers add products to the cart directly from the table?

Yes. The Add to Cart column lets shoppers add products straight from the table without visiting individual product pages – ideal for quick order and wholesale workflows.

Can I display product variations in the table?

Yes, you can show product variations using the variation element.

Can I display product categories, tags, and attributes?

Yes. Built-in elements let you display product categories, tags, and attributes as table columns.

Can customers search and filter products from the front end?

Yes. The lite version includes front-end search and filter controls for category, tag, and attribute.

Can I customize the look and feel of my tables?

Yes. You can adjust colors, fonts, borders, and other visual elements to match your brand. Advanced typography and design controls are available in the Pro version.

Are the tables mobile responsive?

Mobile-responsive tables are a Pro feature, providing an optimized layout for phones and tablets.

Can I import and export product tables between sites?

Yes – import / export is available in the Pro version, making it easy to move tables between staging and production, or to back them up.

Where can I get support?

Free users can post in the WordPress.org support forum. Pro users get priority support from our team. You can also browse our documentation.
